basic_info.description: This bright and airy Noe Valley condo offers sweeping panoramic views of San Francisco that will take your breath away. Open on three sides with expansive windows flood the home with natural light, creating a seamless connection between indoor comfort and the city skyline beyond. The thoughtfully designed layout has many desirable features including an option to add a bathroom and a bedroom to make it a three bedroom home. Whether you're enjoying a quiet morning coffee or entertaining friends at sunset, the spectacular outlooks set the perfect backdrop. Set within one of San Francisco's most coveted neighborhoods, you'll have the charm of 24th Street's shops, cafs, and restaurants just minutes away, while still enjoying a peaceful, elevated retreat above the city. This is Noe Valley living at its finest. Style, comfort, and views you'll never tire of.
